description: This file defines the BaseFieldDefinition class in Drupal, which is used for defining entity fields, including methods for creating, configuring, and managing field properties, storage, and schema.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\BaseFieldDefinition
classes.description: A class for defining entity fields within Drupal, providing methods for creation, configuration, schema management, and property handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new field definition with a specified type, initializing default settings.

methods.name: createFromFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition based on an existing field storage definition.

methods.name: createFromItemType
methods.description: Creates a field definition from an item type string.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the field name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the field name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the field type.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the field's settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets multiple settings for the field.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting value.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting value.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider of the field.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider of the field.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if the field is translatable.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is translatable.

methods.name: isRevisionable
methods.description: Checks if the field is revisionable.

methods.name: setRevisionable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is revisionable.

methods.name: getCardinality
methods.description: Returns the cardinality of the field.

methods.name: setCardinality
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of items for the field.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the field allows multiple values.

methods.name: setPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Sets constraints for a specific property of the field.

methods.name: addPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Adds constraints to a property of the field.

methods.name: setDisplayOptions
methods.description: Sets display options for the field in forms or views.

methods.name: setDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Sets whether the display can be configured.

methods.name: getDisplayOptions
methods.description: Retrieves display options for a given context.

methods.name: isDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Checks if display is configurable.

methods.name: getDefaultValueLiteral
methods.description: Gets the default value literal.

methods.name: getDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Gets the default value callback.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Gets the default value for an entity.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for default value generation.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Returns the initial value for the field.

methods.name: setInitialValue
methods.description: Sets an initial value for the field.

methods.name: getInitialValueFromField
methods.description: Gets the field used for initial value.

methods.name: setInitialValueFromField
methods.description: Sets the field used for initial value.

methods.name: getOptionsProvider
methods.description: Provides options for a property based on the entity.

methods.name: getPropertyDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a property definition by name.

methods.name: getPropertyDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all property definitions.

methods.name: getPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns all property names.

methods.name: getMainPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the main property name.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization, excluding cached properties.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the target entity type ID.

methods.name: setTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Sets the target entity type ID.

methods.name: getTargetBundle
methods.description: Returns the target bundle.

methods.name: setTargetBundle
methods.description: Sets the target bundle.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the schema for the field.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the schema columns.

methods.name: hasCustomStorage
methods.description: Checks if the field has custom storage.

methods.name: isBaseField
methods.description: Confirms this is a base field.

methods.name: setCustomStorage
methods.description: Sets custom storage behavior.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field storage definition.

methods.name: getUniqueStorageIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for storage.

methods.name: getUniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the field.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the field as deleted or not.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration override for the field.

methods.name: isStorageRequired
methods.description: Checks if storage is required.

methods.name: setStorageRequired
methods.description: Sets whether storage is required.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Deep clones the object, resetting cached properties.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if the field is internal.
